abilities.name: Beyonder Constitution (Foundation)
abilities.description: Anyone who drinks a Beyonder potion gains Spirituality (the fuel of ritual magic and Beyonder powers), Spirit Vision, danger intuition, and access to every ability of that Sequence. Power climbs by swallowing the next lower-numbered potion formula and fully digesting it — digestion is advanced by living out the Sequence's Acting Method, not by rest.
abilities.appearance: Beyonders read to Spirit Vision as layered auras; recent drinkers carry residual potion coloring. Losing control distorts body and mind toward the pathway's mythical-creature form.
abilities.activation: Always active from the moment the first potion is consumed.
abilities.effect: Establishes what every Beyonder can do without a separate ability: sense spirits and auras, perform divination-grade perception only if their pathway grants it, power rituals with Spirituality, and advance along the 22 pathways. Higher Sequences bend reality further but carry stronger madness pressure.
abilities.outcomeGuidance: Treat Sequence as the tiebreaker in any contest between Beyonders of different pathways: the lower-numbered Sequence usually wins, but preparation, Sealed Artifacts, and pathway counters can overturn it.
limitations: A Beyonder can never hold potions of two different pathways above Sequence 5 — divergence kills.
Every use of power draws on finite Spirituality; an exhausted Beyonder is ordinary flesh.
Acting against the Sequence's Acting Method stalls digestion and invites loss of control.
counters: Sealing (Sealed Artifacts, warded barriers) suppresses Beyonder powers outright.
Advantage: a Beyonder who has lost control fights wildly and predictably — bait the rampage.
Disrupting a ritual's ingredients, circle, or chanting aborts the working.
prerequisites: Acquire and drink a Sequence 9 potion of one of the 22 pathways (formula: main + supplementary ingredients).

masteryLadder.name: Low Sequence (9–8)
masteryLadder.requirements: Swallow a Sequence 9 potion, then the Sequence 8 potion of the same pathway.
masteryLadder.benefits: Baseline abilities of both Sequences; minor physical/spiritual enhancement.

masteryLadder.name: Mid Sequence (7–5)
masteryLadder.requirements: Digest each lower potion via its Acting Method; obtain the next formula.
masteryLadder.benefits: Reality-touching powers (illusions, curses, shapeshifting) become reliable.

masteryLadder.name: High Sequence — Saint (4–3)
masteryLadder.requirements: Survive the potion's madness; master the Acting Method completely.
masteryLadder.benefits: Saint-tier authority; near-immortal resilience; regional reputation.

masteryLadder.name: Angel (2–1)
masteryLadder.requirements: Hold a Sequence uniqueness or a god's favor; withstand mythification.
masteryLadder.benefits: Angelic authority over the pathway's domain; resurrection-grade powers.

masteryLadder.name: True God (0)
masteryLadder.requirements: Uniqueness of the pathway plus worship/faith infrastructure.
masteryLadder.benefits: Godhood: the pathway's authority is absolute within its domain.

abilities.name: Knowledge (Devil Worship)
abilities.description: Upon advancement, a Serial Killer will gain a wealth of and master all kinds of knowledge related to Devil worship and its Ritualistic Magic. By creating special or unique killing sprees, they would please and gain favors from Devils. Serial Killers often tend to choose those who exhibit degraded behaviors, often linked to their personal traumas- as victims of their serial killing sprees. Such Serial Killers enjoy creating unique serial killings but also commit their crimes not merely as a role, but also to please the Devils of the Abyss. Once the serial killing cases are closed they would be able to perform the final step of this Ritual, letting them summon the corresponding Devil projection from the Abyss and obtain it's assistance to achieve their desired outcome. By saying foul words in the Devil Language, a mystical connection seemed to form with the Serial Killer, linking them based on their location, creating sinister symbols and patterns, marking the initiation of a ritual to summon the projection of an Abyssal Devil. Even if one's string of murders aren't entirely complete and fell short by a few targets, so long as they meet the minimum threshold, they can expedite the ritual and still summon the Devil; however, this shortcut wouldn’t yield the same effectiveness as the standard procedure. Serial Killers can summon these projections because the Devils respond to the Abyss Pathway's unique abilities, not because those Devils themselves have attained the corresponding status. Theoretically, the summoned Devil projection will obey the Ritual performer; however, if it's rank is too high or it finds a loophole to bypass the ritual's protection, it will obey the corresponding true Devil in the Abyss.

Unique wills, distinct hearts, and a penchant for desires all amalgamate to form the diverse nature of Devils. Certain Devils can skin humans and perform complicated processes to form Beyonder items with usage or time limitations. No matter who it is, as long as they wear the human skin this Devil made as clothes, they can transform into the other person and disguise themselves.

abilities.name: Danger Premonition (Malice Perception)
abilities.description: They can sense and grasp the place of origin of danger, as well as who this danger is from. In this way, the Devil can precisely devise countermeasures, take revenge, or nip the threat in the bud. Different Devils have different degrees of this intuition. Unlike a Monster's Danger Premonition, theirs doesn’t stem from Fate but from the Abyss. Their Danger Premonition requires 3 conditions to be met before it can activate: If an existence is a fatal threat to the Devil and can cause life-threatening harm to them; Said existence is intending on doing such harm within a certain period and range; Said existence proceeds to actually act upon their intentions to harm the Devil. Different variations of Devils would possess different degrees of Danger Premonition. The 'certain period' of sensing danger via Danger Premonition for some Devils can range from just a measly few minutes, to a whole entire 24 hours. The range of a Devil’s Danger Premonition may only span from a few miles- or in other cases- span the range of an entire metropolitan area. Apart from this, they aren’t good at Divination or other methods of sensing danger.

abilities.name: Devil Transformation
abilities.description: They can temporarily transform into a Devil, increasing their size, strength and speed. This lets them break free from their bindings. Creatures of different races will have different appearances after becoming Devils, but all of them possess certain characteristics. A pair of goat horns filled with countless mysterious patterns grow from their head. A pair of colossal bat wings unfolds from their back, swirling with light blue flames that emit the strong smell of sulfur. They grow to nearly 3 meters tall and their skin undergoes profound mutations. Although it appears dull, it is actually a sinister, deep black. Their entire body seems to be cloaked with thick and hard armor. Their blood and flesh has extreme elasticity and defensive strength. In this state, they can launch 10-20 Sulfur Fireballs simultaneously. They also possess a wide range of Spells, encompassing the fields of Flames, Poison, and Filth which include: Sulfur Fireball: This launches light blue Fireballs that create powerful explosions and poisons anyone or anything that comes into contact with the Flames. Outside Devil Transformation, they can only launch 3 Sulfur Fireballs at at time. Sword of Lava: This creates a massive blade shaped Flaming sword that looks like a scimitar in design and holds extremely high attack power. Its damage against non-undead and non-corrupted creatures is significantly higher than a Priest of Light's Light of Holiness. One strike could directly cleave through a thick stone column, leaving the sliced off end to appear to be melted off. Flame Cage: This ignites a light blue flame at the palm of their hand, which can solidify into a Cage. This can be used to catch and trap bullets. Other spells include Poisonous Flame Manipulation, Volcanic Eruption, Highly Toxic Vapor, etc.

This will cover the enemy's body with a slightly viscous black liquid, which then explodes into corrupted black fog.

abilities.name: Malice Incarnation
abilities.description: Malice never dies, neither do Demons. 'They' can plant a Seed of Malice deep within a target's psyche. When 'Their' main body is destroyed, 'They' can Resurrect within the target's Mind, igniting the target's Desires and Blood and killing the target. If 'Their' target's main body has a connected psyche to other bodies (e.g. an Unaging's Mirror Self), those psyches will also be eroded as well. Using the Robe of Divine Blood, Emlyn White revived within Katarina Pelle's Mirror Self after she herself resurrected, killing her in the process. A Bloody Archduke's Seed of Malice is also able to catalyze the Malice of the target, making the affected target temporarily Cold-Blooded. If the target commits a truly Malicious act during this period, they will fall further into Depravity until they fall into an Abyss. This can both cause a target to fall into Depravity as well as be transported to the actual Abyss because of the fact that the Abyss is in everyone's heart. Affected by this, indescribable ravings echoed in Katarina Pelle's ears, as if her innermost Malicious emotions and desires were singing in unison, causing her to show signs of losing control. As an Angel-level Devil, 'Their' intense Malice and Desires can overpower other entities' mental control abilities over 'Them', be it from active influence or passive effect. A Bribe can be anywhere between giving a target money to throwing an object near the direction of the target; even if the target does not 'accept' the object, it still counts as a Bribe. There are 4 types of Bribes: Weaken, Charm, Arrogance, and Connection. Weaken: For a certain amount of time, this significantly weakens the target's attacks, defenses, and control over the Briber. Arrogance: The target will become proud and Arrogant, lowering their intelligence and leading them to make erroneous judgments. Charm: The target will feel a great sense of fondness, making it difficult to have any thoughts of animosity or even wish to fight the Briber. If the conditions are suitable, the person who received the Bribe has an extremely small chance of attacking their companions. Connection: This establishes a connection between the target and the Briber.

abilities.name: Distortion
abilities.description: They can use the loopholes found in Order. By Distorting the target's words, actions, and intent, they could formulate a certain Order that provided themself with an advantage, so as to achieve the goal of restraining and influencing their opponent. They can Distort the direction and target of attacks. Mithor King Distorted the trajectory of a bullet upwards slightly, causing it to miss. Klein used Creeping Hunger to Distort the target of Ludwell's Door to the Underworld, using the skeletons and zombies to substitute himself. Using Creeping Hunger, Klein Distorted Kircheis' Sulfur Fireballs, they lost their trajectories and acted chaotically as though in random motion, some even flew backwards at Kircheis himself. Klein used Creeping Hunger to Distort Cynthia's words, turning 'Admiral, I want to have a child with you' to 'Admiral, I only wish to have a child with you.' believing that the bodyguards and male attendants around her to would be pushed away, far away by Cynthia, after having her will Distorted, giving them a chance for a breather. However, his Distortion failed and Cynthia directly resisted his ability. They can Seal ordinary rooms or Unseal confined spaces. The action of 'closing the door' can be Distorted into the rule 'Seal this place, isolate the outside from the inside', one that can withstand the bombardment of several Sulfur Fireballs from a Desire Apostle afflicted with Bribe-Weaken. Mr. A Distorted Bakerland's order to stay away from his room and to not be disturbed, which made it as though the room became a completely isolated world. Lumian Distorted the action of 'opening the door' with the concept of 'Unsealing this confined space' to open the Bottle of Fiction. Other uses of this ability include: Klein used Creeping Hunger and Distorted the goal of 'separate and intercept' into 'separate and take action alone', making Kircheis and his companions separate.

The negative effects of the Hand of Horror caused Audrey to unknowingly make a mistake, making her take a bath in an abnormal procedure. They can Disorder the standards of distance measurement. Bird Mustang covered quite a sizable distance in about eight steps to arrive in front of Nast Solomon's cabin. They can make it so walking to the left would cause one to walk forward. This can cause an Ocean Songster, a Beyonder with exceptional Balance, to hobble forward. In conjunction with Distortion, they can extricate themselves from the control abilities of an enemy and unfavorable situations. One such situation is a Wraith's Possession.

abilities.description: They can boost the effects or influence of their own actions. Under normal circumstances, Magnify could only amplify the effects and influence that strengthened one's body or actions without helping others. For example, assisting a Bizarro Sorcerer in their control of Spirit Body Threads would be impossible unless the Earl of the Fallen is a Marionette with a Worm of Spirit, in that case, the Bizarro Sorcerer would only be Magnifying their own actions. Magnify has been shown to be used in the following ways: They are able to Magnify the attacks and negative effects of Sealed Artifacts and Mystical Items, allowing lower ranked items to significantly affect Demigods. This includes the negative effects of the items on their enemies. They can turn a hug or grab from a distance into a restriction, able to pull a target from nearly 100 meters at least to just inches before them. While under the effects of Exploiting their jumping state, they can Magnify their movements to forcefully change their direction. The injuries they have dealt to their opponents can be Magnified, in some cases, this would make them die on the spot. Strong winds near them can be Magnified into a Hurricane. They can make an ordinary attack become an execution. Magnify cannot be used consecutively in a quick succession. It is limited to a one-time use each time. Magnify is effective on abilities above the Sequence 4 level.

Klein's Air Cannons had it's direction and trajectory Distorted to the right by Qonas Kilgor, significantly missing him in the process. They are able to directly create a Seal in thin air, effectively creating an invisible wall, through just Distorting an act of 'closing a door'. Qonas Kilgor was able to fully Distort his moving trajectory to a large degree, causing him to change directions instantly. They are able to distort the level of a mental disease, such as a Mental Plague from a Manipulator, weakening it and slowing down the deterioration. Distortion can cause a bullet's trajectory to be ridiculously off its mark and simultaneously cause its power to be extremely lacking. Using the Qonas Kilgor Marrionette, Klein used Distortion to circumvent the isolation and stay hidden into the darkness created by Nibbs' wings.

abilities.name: Distortion & Definition Authorities
abilities.description: 'They' have partial authorities over Distortion and Definition. A Prince of Abolition is able to re-Define and Distort the existing Order to 'Their' advantage in order to achieve 'Their' desired goals. For example, 'They' can Define what counts as a Substitute, what is the 'original body', what counts as Bribery, who is 'corrupted', how to instantly transform the original body into a Substitute, how to turn normal behavior into Bribery, and so on. In the midst of 'His' silence, George Augustus III silently swapped 'Himself' with a Substitute, which was the Imagined version of 'Him' doing the speech. 'Their' Distortion directly Distorts the corresponding Order and Rules (not the underlying ones). With great difficulty, George Augustus III split off some of 'His' strength, and with the help of the preparations 'He' had put in place, 'He' forcefully Distorted the surrounding area and isolated the dark and solemn secret mausoleum from the real world, preventing earthquakes and meteors from approaching the target.

abilities.name: Autocrat Authority
abilities.description: A core authority of the Black Emperor, and an authority under the Shadow of Order symbolism. Under it are the subordinate authorities like Distortion, Exploit, Definition and Strata. Except for the Strata authority, all the other subordinate authorities are based on Order, by Exploiting Loopholes within Order or Distorting the original intent of it, the Black Emperor can make Order serve 'Their' own purposes. In barren and dead places, both the Justiciar and the Black Emperor can rebuild a complete set of Order suitable for human survival. The Justiciar relies on the original fundamental Rules to recreate an Order suitable for human survival, while the Black Emperor Distorts the original Rules to make them suitable for humans. The effect is the same, but the methods of realization differ. In comparison, the Sun's Order is more positive, self-centered, and exclusive, and must derive from 'Their' previous standard of justice. There is an overlap and intersection in the authority of Order between the Black Emperor Pathway and the Sun Pathway.

abilities.name: Distortion Authority
abilities.description: 'They' hold the authority of Distortion. The authority of Distortion has been shown to be used in the following ways: 'They' can Distort the extension direction of Spirit Body Threads, making those who can see it unable to detect the target in advance. 'They' are able to disrupt Teleportation by Distorting the destination of the Teleportation, turning everything extremely chaotic. 'They' can delay the consequence of an effect by constantly Distorting their state back to when the effect's activity is only gradual. 'They' can Distort the spatial position between a used Substitute, swapping the positions of the Substitute and the main body. Using this on a Fool Pathway Beyonder will result in them forcibly appearing in the desired position once they exit the Historical Void. The rules and process to use Sealed Artifacts can be disrupted and Distorted, stopping the user from activating their power. 'They' are able to Distort the True Vision of onlookers, causing them to see scene of the past from one or two seconds ago. 'They' can Distort the rules of Concealed spaces, making its entrance appear directly before 'Them'. When 'They' advance to become a Black Emperor or start 'Their' revival process, it will cause various Distortions to manifest in reality. Spirit World Traversals will be Distorted, causing the user to discover that their intended destination is far away, or that their Wandering has ended abruptly. High Sequence Error Pathway Beyonders will have the connection to 'Their' external Worms of Time be Distorted, losing the ability to command 'Them'. The rules of the Circle Inhabitant will be Distorted, allowing leaving the area of the Circle Inhabitant without it triggering the Loop. In different parts of the world: Some people may find themselves back home despite having just left; Others might see their bright cathedrals turn dark and silent; Some might be habitually drinking milk but wouldn't notice they were using their nostrils, suffering no harm; Long-abandoned compulsory education schools might strangely light up, as if filled with students quietly attending classes. After fulfilling certain conditions, the Black Emperor will be able to Distort the faith and mystical connections that point to the Great Old Ones. Roselle forcefully Distorted the faith of the Uncertain Mist's followers to 'Himself' using 'His' authority, the Black Emperor Pathway's connection with the Uncertain Mist, and the corruption of the Uncertain Mist while relying on the Astral Barrier. This granted 'Him' absolute authority over the Uncertain Mist followers but also deepened 'His' connection to the Uncertain Mist. Roselle Gustav Distorted the relationship between the main body and the external items, briefly making 'Himself' an appendage of the Genie. Allowing Amon, as the Error, to use this firm and close connection to severely injure the Uncertain Mist by severely injuring the Genie.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: Even if 'They' were to be truly annihilated and killed, Death is a part of the most underlying and core part of the Order of reality, thus, the Black Emperor can be resurrected. 'They' will still be able to awaken and return from one of the mausoleums 'They' made for 'Their' apotheosis. There are three stages in the process of 'Their' Resurrection: The Uniqueness leaves the person possessing it, turning into an abstract concept. The subjects ruled by the Black Emperor will hear 'Their' mighty voice again. 'They' will fuse with the Uniqueness and would reappear in the Astral World. The Sequence 1 characteristics would be returned to 'Their' hands. Whether the Sequence 1 characteristics come with the corresponding Sequences 9-2 characteristics depends on the state of the Sequence 1 characteristic itself. 'Their' Resurrection is an Order that other True Gods are unable to Distort or prevent. It can be interfered with in the following known scenarios: The birth of a new Black Emperor. The intervention of a God formed from the Black Emperor Uniqueness + 2 Black Emperor Sequence 1 + 1 Justiciar Sequence 1. The birth of The Anarchy. With the Lord of Mysteries' help, 'They' could still Resurrect through the Rules, but 'They' would only be able to reclaim two portions of the Prince of Abolition Beyonder characteristics. Deliberately terminating the Resurrection process 'Themselves'. This would leave 'Them' as an incomplete Sequence 0. 'They' would then live in a special state inside 'Their' mausoleum, without the Uniqueness and Beyonder Characteristics. How long it takes for the retrieval of the Prince of Abolition Beyonder Characteristics and the total duration of the Resurrection still depends on related arrangements. Unlike Solomon, Roselle's Resurrection was fast since Adam took the initiative to give the characteristics and the Black Emperor Uniqueness to him. 'Their' Resurrection can cleanse the Corruption and madness brought by multiple different pathway Beyonder Characteristics, but can't cleanse the Corruption and madness that's intrinsic to itself. For the latter, it includes the following known scenarios: Failing the Apotheosis Ritual. The Corruption and madness brought along by the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Even if 'They' were killed and had all nine mausoleums destroyed, if a certain amount of the Order set up by 'Them' remained, it is still possible for 'Them' to mysteriously Revive. This appears to be a Loophole against the natural Order of death. Ancient Gods with the Black Emperor Uniqueness like the Mutated King Kvastir could also Resurrect with this mechanism, provided that 'They' had prepared thoroughly.

abilities.name: Werewolf Transformation
abilities.description: They can turn into a Werewolf, growing short, erect hair as fur, turning their nails sharp, long, and firm, like claws, while possessing some Spell-like abilities. While in this form, they will possess terrifying strength, agility, regeneration, and speed. A Werewolf's claws and teeth are equivalent to Beyonder weapons of the same Sequence, capable of destroying thinner steel plates in addition to being poisonous. They are particularly weak to the theurgical Spell-like abilities or Spells from the Sun domain such as a Solar High Priest's Holy Light Summoning. A Werewolf possesses powerful regenerative abilities. This is a trait that will remain even when they exit their Werewolf Transformation form. Even if a hideous wound appears on their abdomen and their intestines spill out, they will only need to wash it with water, stuff the intestines back in, and pinch the side of the gap with one's hands. Eventually the wound will heal. A Werewolf can regrow their teeth. They can outrun a gray wolf while chasing it at full speed. Werewolves can transform partially in order to utilize some of their capabilities. If they don't give up on self-control, they will be in so much pain that they will lose their ability to fight. If they indulge themselves, they will become less and less like a human, and the risk of losing control is very high. The Zombie's Curse replaces the Werewolf's and Lunatic's Curse. It can be limited with the use of certain medicines such as sedatives, however, they would eventually build up resistance against that specific type of medicine, rendering it ineffective. abilities.description: They are able to turn themselves into a Spirit Body, a Wraith, thus obtaining all the general corresponding powers and special traits. As a fusion of spirit and flesh, Wraiths have tremendous resilience in both their mind and body, being able to survive after they lose their head. Psychic attacks like an Interrogator's Psychic Piercing typically wouldn't significantly affect them. A Wraith can even cause the psychic attack to backfire on their opponent. Should a Wraith be incapacitated, they will lack the corresponding ability to reflect such psychic attacks onto their opponents. They are weak to Purification powers such as Light of Holiness from a Priest of Light and Lightning Strike from an Ocean Songster when in their Spirit Body state. Demon-Hunting and Exorcism-type Mystical Items, Sealed Artifacts, and Beyonder powers can hurt a Wraith, but it would not be fatal or very dangerous to them. They can go without eating or drinking for about 2 weeks and are immune to biological poison, regular flames, and many forms of physical attacks. Purely physical weapons or firearms without special powers cannot harm Wraiths. Their existence as a Wraith allows them to avoid instant death when entering the Underworld, however, lingering for too long will prevent them from reverting to their human form, forever existing as a true Wraith. A Wraith is able to temporarily avoid the Underworld's influence by Possessing an undead creature. Wraiths also possess various auxiliary and support abilities and traits. Most of these abilities aren't unique as they are common in many normal Wraiths and spirits.

Even when they are Possessing a target, a Wraith will not at all be restrained in their capabilities, being able to become Intangible and utilize their abilities freely. They can accelerate Beyonder Characteristic separation from a corpse by Possessing the target, killing them in that state, and having full control over the body. Using a simple Ritual they gained along with Possessing a target's body, a Wraith can help a person draw things realistically from said person's memories. If their target has a strong body, the Wraith can make them directly commit suicide by decapitation using the target's own bare hands. If the target is killed by a physical attack with the Wraith still possessing them, the Wraith will be unharmed as they are immune. If the target is killed by some other type of attack that can affect the Wraith, they will suffer the corresponding damage. If the target's body is fragmented, the Wraith can pull back the pieces and reassemble them, albeit with some remaining damage.

In order to transform themselves into mystical puppets identical to their target, a Puppet will first need to form an established connection. To prepare for a Curse, Sharron established a connection by Possessing Klarman. At Sequence 4, they can only hurt the enemy by hurting themselves. Any damage to them will be reflected on the connected target and vice versa. Upon forming a connection, Sharron grabbed the exaggerated crack that had the Crimson Moon on her head and pressed down, causing Klarman to let out a blood-curdling scream. Sharron, in her state as a figurine of Klarman, had yanked some of her messy, black-and-white hair. This in turn caused a tuff of Klarman's hair to fall out as well.

abilities.description: Every Puppet can awaken and control all lifeless objects within a certain range. This allows them to utilize their surroundings as weapons and traps. They can control ownerless Sealed Artifacts and Mystical Items that are not held or controlled by anyone physically or through Spirituality. The General of the Pupil-less Eye controlled the Vision of White immediately after the Sealed Artifact was thrown by Emlyn White, forming a pillar of light that enveloped Sharron. Puppets are able to transform inanimate objects in their surroundings into weapons they can shoot out at high speeds. The General of the Pupil-less Eye let out a scream, shattering the surrounding windows that turned into bullets that shot towards the floating Sharron. They can control objects that are in contact with living beings, including Demigods. Shanks tightened Klein Moretti's clothes as if a bear were giving him a hug, almost shattering his ribs and preventing movement as paper figurines covered his face to prevent him from breathing. A Disciple of Silence using Source of Curses doesn't need to hurt themselves to affect the target but could do so anyways to enhance a Curse's effectiveness. Sharron opted to pluck her eye reflecting Mirror Roselle Gustav to enhance a Curse that had the capability of banishing the latter deep within the Spirit World. Furthermore, the target would be subjected to constant attacks from dangerous creatures in the Spirit World while being banished. They are also capable of using Source of Curses to achieve effects like banishment, fixation, and sleep through different methods or corresponding media. Sharron transformed herself into a dim and stiff doll, then encased herself in layers of Ice which simultaneously emerged around Oxyto's child, fixing it in place within an Ice Cage.

At this level, a Transfiguration Curse can only affect a single entity at a time. Entities contained within a target are treated as part of the same whole, thus turning both into a single animal. Its effects are symmetrical, transferring across connected bodies, such as a Demoness of Unaging and their Mirror Selves. A dormant Mirror Person is exempt from this, however, because their true body is reduced to a defenseless animal, their Resurrection arrangements become vulnerable. Both living and non-living objects can be affected by this Curse. Traits or Beyonder powers that don't get stripped from the corresponding Beyonders include: Madame: The trait of New Life, which they can use to corrupt themselves and be reborn. Chaos Hunter: The Sword of Judgment, which can return their original appearance. Demoness of Unaging: The trait of Resurrection through their dormant Mirror Self. Discerner: Through usage of a Psychological Cue, a Discerner is able to believe themselves to still be powerful.

If 'They' understand a target's core information, 'They' can create Paper Figurines, Puppets, or other mediums to Curse the other party from afar, or even cause them to die suddenly. Suah's Historical Projection created a doll that looked like Klein Moretti, using the latter's Worm of Spirit to create a connection between the two, which Zaratul used to isolate the main body from all his Marionettes and prevent him from entering Sefirah Castle. The patterns, designs, ornaments, and every detail on the vessel are manifestations of different Curses, and any living being that sees it would suffer the corresponding Curse. The surrounding environment will also be affected by 'Their' Mythical Creature Form, distorted by nature and becoming tainted with various weakened Curses.

Now, merely any target that is reflected in 'Their' eyes can be Cursed and transformed accordingly. The limbs left behind by a Beyonder after them undergoing a Transfiguration contain a portion of their Beyonder Characteristics that couldn't return to the main body. Multiple targets at a time can be affected by a single Transfiguration Curse, and there is almost no limit for the duration a target can be in the Cursed state. Apart from putting up resistance from someone at the same level, one can use the correct method to remove it. No Curse is irreversible. There are always exploitable Loopholes. Otherwise, the Transfiguration Curse cannot be dispelled. 'They' can create Curses rooted in one's hatred, anger, and grudges. Reinette Tinekerr, who had created a Curse whose root has lied in the anger, hatred, and 'Her' grudge that had emerged after 'She' suffered an attack, used it in order to repel a piece of 'distorted' wood as well as stagger and stun Abomination Suah for a second.

The outward manifestation of 'Their' complete Mythical Creature Form depends on 'Their' own self-awareness and the choices made during 'Their' Advancement, which uses an ancient, evil item that can bear Angel-level power which is used to Bind the aggregate Curses. Reinette Tinekerr's Mythical Creature Form is a castle-sized doll with blood-red eyes, dressed in a black gothic dress with countless mysterious symbols and sinister vines. For those like Suah and Tirié who have not completed the corresponding rituals, 'They' exhibit outward forms that are amplifications of 'Their' Beyonder Characteristics. By relying on 'Their' inherent vessel and corresponding symbol, an Ancient Bane can enter the Historical Void; however, 'They' are not able to surpass the era in which the vessel appeared. Within the parts 'They' can trace back to, an Ancient Bane is able to counter the History of the Fool Pathway to some extent. This is achieved through Curses.

abilities.name: Transformation
abilities.description: The Curse of an Abomination can not only deform the surrounding creatures, but also transform them into Werewolves, Zombies, Puppets and other Deviant species. However, these Deviant Puppets can only be maintained for a short time and will soon be devoured by madness, turning into corpses or flesh tainted by the curse. 'They' can display 'Their' true form as Abominations, gaining the corresponding abilities. In 'Their' true form, 'Their' arms will lengthen; it's surface dark and sticky with a strange liquid flowing from it. Pale skulls, eyeballs with obvious blood vessels, tongues with fangs, and all sorts of other strange-shaped things will grow out from the strange liquid. 'They' can emit an eerie roar that pierces the spirit, causing all surrounding creatures to tremble, be somewhat stiff, and suddenly go blank in the mind, briefly losing all thoughts. Abomination Suah's roar had caused the surrounding individuals near 'Him' to suddenly pause in movement, their minds going blank and thoughts lost. 'Their' true form in this state, not 'Their' Mythical Creature Form, inherently carries the effects of Madness, Evil, Distortion, Chaos, Hatred, Indulgence, and Curse. This will cause effects equivalent to revealing 'Their' Mythical Creature Form in 'Their' area as well as a strong inclination for extreme madness and Evil. One could say that 'Their' true forms were a product of 'Their' self-perception combined with 'Their' complete Mythical Creature Form. In 'Their' true form, 'They' are able to extend 'Their' own deformed arms into the sky and into the ground in order to Seal the surroundings.

abilities.name: Curses Authority
abilities.description: 'They' gain more power over this authority. 'They' can create Curses normally undetectable even by Saints and that can hit the main body through any connection, making the target to suffer an unexpected and sudden death. In an attempt to suppress Klein Moretti, a Historical Projection of Abomination Suah which was controlled by Zaratul Cursed a Marionette that 'He' had controlled. Abomination Suah had formed a Curse that hit Klein Moretti's main body (which was in the Historical Void) through a Historical Projection that he was operating. 'They' can cause the surrounding Spirituality to deviate, seemingly forming layer upon layers of barriers in an attempt to restrain the target in place and restrict their movements. This is the effect of a Curse upon the environment. While Suah restricted Klein's body and Soul, the surroundings also formed a barrier as the scarlet flames Klein came out of from Flaming Jump bound him to the ground. Near Suah's area, the surrounding Spirituality had transformed into layers of barriers that restrained and restricted Klein and Reinette Tinekerr's every action. Similarly, 'They' can cause the vicinity to boil, covering it in viscous black liquid that erodes upwards into the void, disrupting the overlap between Reality and the Spirit World. However, this doesn't immediately disable abilities that use the Spirit World like Teleportation, needing time to completely take effect. Even if a target wasn't directly attacked by 'Them' or is a main target of 'Their' attacks, 'They' can still cause them to face constant erosion and Curses without their knowledge. This affects and makes one's Spirituality 'frozen' slightly, seemingly restraining the body and Soul. As the degree of harmony between their body and Soul gradually decreases, their body will gradually be a prison for the spirit, making their movements more stiff and heavy. Suah used this on Klein, causing the harmony of his body and Soul to decrease, making his actions and movements be more rigid, slow, and heavy.

Deviants are monsters formed by the negative effects of Beyonder Characteristics, including Devils and those who have lost control on other Pathways. All Deviants are naturally suppressed when facing the Chained, and those at low to mid Sequences may directly become 'Their' loyal servants. The Chained can allow every type of Deviant to pray to 'Them' in the simplest manner and receive 'Their' response and assistance. Using a roar formed from superimposed Ancient Hermes words that exceeded human comprehension, Suah indirectly received a response from the Chained God who descended with 'His' projection.

In this aspect, if something does not reach the level of Sealing, the Chained is stronger than the Door; however, the Door surpasses the Chained within the Sealing domain. With proper use of Temperance, a King of Angels of this Pathway can make the Chained Uniqueness and 3 Abomination Beyonder Characteristics exist simultaneously within 'Their' body without triggering a qualitative change. This prevents immediate loss of control or death on the spot. The Chained can sever the connection between Reality and the Spirit World, Restraining Beyonder powers that rely on direct usage of the Spirit World. The more familiar they are with the place, and the more trust or support they receive from the people there, the more they can exert abilities beyond their own capabilities and receive some assistance from the environment. Once they exceed their Jurisdiction range, or if they have just acquired Jurisdiction and are not yet familiar with it, they can only rely on their own Beyonder powers. Their area of Jurisdiction is approximately the size of a small town. If they receive an official appointment from the authorities, the area under their administration can be larger, but it must not exceed 5 times the normal limit.

abilities.description: This Beyonder power causes bolts of lightning appear within and shoot out from their eyes to attack their target at an effective distance of 5 meters. It can impose pressure on the Spirit Body, focus the mind, ignore the physical body, pierce the target's Soul, and directly attack their Spirit Body, bringing unbearable pain. Psychic Piercing isn't a Beyonder power that disrupted with thoughts or affected the mind, but is a means to directly attack the Spirit Body. In essence, while other abilities act on the Body of Heart and Mind, Psychic Piercing's target is the Soul Body instead, the two are significantly different.

abilities.description: A Judge's Authority have undergone a qualitative change, not only making them have an indescribable aura that makes people around them subconsciously avoid their gazes but also being able to influence the environment. They can use Mystical Languages such as Ancient Hermes to establish new Rules or make a corresponding Verdict for a certain area. Everything within that area must abide by the Rules or the Verdict's outcome and violations will result in being bound by the Rules. Both the Judge's Spirituality and Rules limit Verdict to a degree.

abilities.name: Prohibition
abilities.description: Pushing forward with an open palm, a Judge can use Ancient Hermes to establish a rule forbidding certain actions or Beyonder powers, forcing everyone within a certain range to comply with the Prohibition. Prohibitions generally follow this format: ''X' is Prohibited here'. Some of the examples of the Beyonder powers and actions a Judge can Prohibit include the following: Flight, floating, Teleportation, Invisibility, etc. When it comes to the Prohibition of Invisibility, those who are hidden in shadows won't be compelled to reveal themselves, as they weren't invisible to begin with. They had merely shape-shifted into a shadow being, blending with the shadows. At its current level, Prohibition targeting specific races or individuals cannot directly kill the target; it can only cause continuous suppression or repel them from the Prohibition's area of effect. Such Prohibitions that are directly aimed at a particular existence will be quickly suppressed if there is a level difference. Examples of this are Prohibiting the existence of beings such as Specters and Wraiths within an area. With preparation and only providing assistance, it can influence even Saints to a certain extent, though not necessarily effectively, but it can cause some disruption. Xio caused Botis's normally instantaneous Teleportation to be blocked by a rusty, abnormally heavy door—something that couldn't keep him from leaving after making adjustments.

abilities.name: Balance Authority
abilities.description: 'They' gain partial authority over Balance. 'They' can divide the battlefield, separating the various sides into different areas while roughly ensuring a Balance of power in each battlefield. Before ending their own battle and making the corresponding battlefield cease to exist, neither Angels nor Saints can interfere in other battles. Even a Planeswalker will be locked in their respective area, preventing them from joining other battlefields. If one side becomes too strong, members who exceed the Balance limit will be excluded from the battlefield within a short period of time. This will last anywhere between 10 seconds to 2 minutes, within that time, those affected will be unable to participate in the battle. Alternatively, these members could freely choose their own battlefield if the Balancer does not prevent them from doing so. The underlying Rule is to end Disorder, restore Order, and enforce Balance, however, this may not necessarily mean perfect Balance. Consequently, this Balance can Distorted by a Duke of Entropy. The Rule created by the Pillar of Severity created a disparity in strength between the two sides when including Sealed Artifacts. The Sun could not use the Proof of Glory due to its characteristics, while the Demoness of Gold could freely use the Eye of God. Using Solomon's Mask, Judgment Distorted the Balance to become more extreme, allowing her and the Demoness of Orange to join the Sun and the Demoness of Gold, while forcing Mirror Roselle Gustav and the Demoness of Black to face Temperance who wielded the Box of the Great Old Ones. In a one-on-one situation, a Balancer can forcibly reduce or increase the enemy's strength to a level roughly equivalent to their own within 1 minute. The stronger the enemy, the shorter the duration of this Balance with 1 minute being the upper limit. In other words, this meant that the Balancer can be evenly matched with anyone, even a True Deity, though this will only last for 3 seconds. 'They' can sense imbalances and Disorder in the surrounding area, allowing them to detect targets in a Concealed state.

abilities.name: Order Proxy
abilities.description: 'They' are able to establish many new Rules (not at the underlying level) for an entire battlefield, all 'Their' enemies, an entire city, or a small nation. 'They' are able to modify or even temporarily remove existing Rules (not at the underlying level), but these rules cannot be completely fixed and remain in effect permanently. Due to the characteristics of the Justiciar Pathway, if the Nation of Disorder gives permission, 'They' can act as a Proxy. Otherwise, not. It must have a compliant procedure. If the Hand of Order has authorization from the Celestial Thearch, then without harming 'Themselves', 'They' can reach King of Kings of Angels level of strength for 3 seconds. At the cost of certain death, 'They' can reach the level of the weakest tier of Half Great Old One. When the Sefirah has no consciousness and operates via Symbolism, it must use specific methods to possibly succeed. Those specific methods need to be figured out. William Augustus I's Historical Projection announced 'Sealing is prohibited here.', causing shadow that enveloped Utopia to immediately shake as many gaps appeared. It was unable to completely isolate the marionette town from the outside world. 'They' can sense the changes in Order. 'They' can observe the tug-of-war between Disorder and Balance, the evolving Order of the battlefield, and the enemy forces' formation, carefully calculating the Rules, and what kind of Order should be established. William Augustus I managed to sense the death of George III through the changes in Order. 'They' can quell Disorder and Anomalies, exist in an independent position, and control the effects. After dividing the battlefield into different sections, William Augustus I's Historical Projection stood at an isolated spot, ensuring that none of the aftershocks attacked the mausoleum below.

abilities.name: Order Authority
abilities.description: The Justiciar possesses the Order authority and its corresponding subordinate authorities over Rules, Laws, Principles, etc. 'They' can modify the underlying Rules of the world to some extent. Compared to the Paragon's ability to change Laws of Physics versus the Justiciar's ability to change the underlying Rules, the Justiciar is stronger as it also effects mystical Rules. The Trunsoest Brass Book has Rules presented in grayish-black that, if it were able to awaken further, it could change and do the following modifications: 'Scholar of Yore has the ability to summon Historical Void Projections. The success rate of Summoning depends on the familiarity and friendliness of the target...' It might have reduced the success rate of summoning Historical Void Projections. 'When one's rationality drops to 20% of its original value, there would be signs of losing control...' It may cause Beyonders to show signs of losing control if their rationality falls a little. 'They' can make certain modifications to the Rules of the Red Priest's Sacrifices. 'They' are able to remove existing, non-underlying Rules. 'They' are able to establish various new Rules for the world. These Rules can't be fundamental but they will be permanent, with an effect ranging from small to large, from a single nation to a planet or a star system. The Son of Chaos can even influence the Laws of Beyonder Characteristics such as Indestructibility, Convergence, and Separation to a certain extent, making limited, low-level, and small-scale modifications. Rules have to be publicized or announced before it could truly be effective. Thus, Concealing the announcement of those Laws will make them ineffective. The Rules can be made stricter over time with each additional clause. It can reach a level where it will be impossible for a person to abide by 'Their' Laws. The Rules that had been created will restrict 'Them' as well. However, 'They' could get rid of those Rules to break the restriction. 'They' can theoretically create a method for Resurrection; however, the Rules involved must be mutually reinforcing and can't directly stipulate 'Their' Revival. For instance, 'They' can establish that the Souls of the deceased in this area remain preserved and do not enter the Spirit World. Then 'They' need to specify the duration of Soul preservation before stipulating that Ghosts can retain their memories. Only then, through step-by-step regulations, can Resurrection be achieved. However, this approach is overly complex and easily disrupted. The Trunsoest Brass Book set several different Rules, each with its own corresponding Judgment when broken. 'Lost items are regarded as abandonment.' 'All living beings are equal before the Law. Even Angels can be killed by ordinary people'. 'Resurrection of the deceased is prohibited here!' This weakened the will of the Celestial Worthy awakening inside the body of Klein. 'Without my permission, no living being can leave this place.' This prevented Klein Moretti's Spirit Body from leaving and entering Sefirah Castle. In barren and dead places, both the Justiciar and the Black Emperor can rebuild a complete set of Order suitable for human survival. The Justiciar relies on the original fundamental Rules to recreate an Order suitable for human survival, while the Black Emperor will Distort the original Rules to make them suitable for humans. The effect is the same, but the methods of realization differ. The Justiciar can grant Immunity to specific individuals. This will enable those individuals to disregard the effects of indiscriminate Rules.
